commonNotes.null: CDL values are never null and carry no status. Every hx.comps comp has its own null and status rule, given among its departures. A G36 sequence sees the difference only when an input point is null, stale or faulted.
commonNotes.unary: UnaryMath: a null `inA` gives null `out`. An invalid `inA` is still computed and its status is copied to `out` (UnaryMath.fan onExecute).
commonNotes.binary: BinaryMath: a null input gives null `out`. An invalid input gives NaN with the merged status. A unit error gives NaN with fault (BinaryMath.fan onExecute).
commonNotes.quad: QuadMath computes from the valid inputs and skips a null or invalid one. Fewer valid inputs than the comp needs give null `out`. Otherwise `out` merges the status of every input, valid or not, so an invalid status propagates as the spec doc says (QuadMath.fan:55-60, a bitwise OR in Status.fan:264; math.xeto:83-85). A unit error adds fault.
commonNotes.quadLogic: QuadLogic computes from the valid inputs and skips a null or invalid one. Fewer non-null inputs than the comp needs give null `out`. Otherwise `out` merges the status of every input, so an invalid status propagates as the spec doc says (QuadLogic.fan:53-58, a bitwise OR in Status.fan:264; logic.xeto:20-22).
commonNotes.compare: Comparison: a null input gives null `out`. An invalid input gives false with the merged status. Mismatched units give false with fault (Comparison.fan onExecute).
commonNotes.equalUnit: Equal is false when the two inputs carry different non-null units (Comparison.fan Equal.eq). CDL Integers carry none, so an Integer that picked up a unit upstream compares unequal.
commonNotes.switch: ValSwitch: a null `inSwitch` gives null `out`. An invalid `inSwitch` holds the last `out` (Switch.fan ValSwitch.onExecute).
commonNotes.transientFeed: The target slot is transient, so a fixed value must arrive on a linked NumberConst. A value set on a transient slot is not saved (logic.xeto:75-76).
commonNotes.nullHold: A null input gives null outputs and an invalid input holds them with the merged status, keeping the state (cited in the comp doc).
commonNotes.ownClock: Timed comps see time only at executes, so an event resolves on the first execute at or after it. A step of the clock backward counts as no time. State is not persisted and restarts from initial values after a task rebuild.
commonNotes.sampleGrid: Instants sit on a grid of whole periods from 1 Jan 1970 UTC, so a period of 1day aligns to 00:00 UTC, not local midnight (sampling.xeto:10-13). A period shorter than the cycle cannot be met.
commonNotes.noDefaultPeriod: CDL `samplePeriod` has no default. The comp defaults `period` to 1min (sampling.xeto:62, 124).
commonNotes.triggered: TriggeredComp reads the rise of `trigger` on execute. A `trigger` true on consecutive executes is one rise. A null input gives null `out` and an invalid input holds `out`. A rise while `in` is null, invalid or NaN takes no sample (triggered.xeto:9-21).
commonNotes.pulseOneExecute: CDL gives a true output at the event instant only. The comp holds it true for one execute and clears it on the next cycle (logic.xeto:132-135).
commonNotes.stall: The comp executes every cycle and steps on its own CycleClock. A step longer than both 1min and 10 times the longest of the last 8 steps is a stall or a gap. Results depend on the cycle length.
commonNotes.roundRules: Round: a null `in` gives null `out` and an invalid `in` gives NaN with its status (math.xeto:187-188).
